included.title: Kimp Graphics
body: is our power-packed graphic design subscription. Unlike other companies that provide multiple tiers of service and a very limited standard subscription, Kimp offers one graphic design subscription. And it includes ALL the designs you need, without having to pay extra premiums. From print and digital designs for your day to day marketing, to custom illustrations (including detailed brand mascots!), landing page designs, GIFS for unique campaigns AND website & app development to turn your designs into working products. We know that your design needs can evolve and vary and so we’ve created one subscription that’s versatile enough to handle everything you need.

included.title: Kimp Video
body: is our video design and motion graphics subscription. With Kimp Video you can get help enhancing your existing video footage or images, or we’ll design and animate from scratch for you! We provide this range of design and animation services as part of Kimp Video because we know that your video content needs will be dynamic, depending on whether you’re creating something for your website, an email campaign, social media, or something in between. And we’re prepared to deliver a wide range of videos to help you with that.

included.title: Kimp Graphics + Video
body: includes all the features of Kimp Graphics and all the features of Kimp Video, plus website & app development, for a discounted flat monthly fee!
And, with every Kimp subscription, you can invite as many additional team members as you’d like to help you make and manage design requests at no extra cost!
